_comment: Step 1 output: the 5 data-driven targets + difficulty assignment + evidence. See docs/phase5/LOCAL_FT_RESULTS.md for the full writeup. min_positive_verses threshold = 150 (14 subtypes qualified; restricted further to the 10 that are in-scope subtypes defined in experiments/phase3_subelements/subtype_defs.py -- the other 4 qualifying raw labels (اشتقاق/ترديد/مبالغة/رد الأعجاز على الصدور) are different rhetorical devices outside this project's 4-element scope and have no LLM difficulty evidence to rank against).

targets.weak_evidence_flag: Phase1 TEST-scale breakdown (PROJECT_STATE.md §3c) found this the EASIEST Trope subtype (29-33% missed) -- a corrected finding that overturned an earlier DEV-only read. But Phase3 crossmodel recall is sharply model-dependent for this same subtype (Gemini 0.143 = hardest-looking of all reliable subtypes; GPT 0.571 = one of the best) -- both docs independently flag this subtype's history of small-sample-sensitive, surprising swings. Placed as 'easy' on the stronger (larger-n, TEST-scale) Phase1 evidence, but this is the least internally-consistent of the 5 targets.

targets.note: Forced medium reference per task instruction -- directly comparable to E1/E1 v2 (same subtype, same GT convention, verified: eval_pool_25's 327 verse-units / 127 GT-positives reproduced exactly by this phase's own data_io.py). Richest evidence base of the 5 targets (dedicated Phase1 + Phase3 + E1/E1v2 experiments).

targets.weak_evidence_flag: Only Antonymy candidate above the verse threshold (forced choice for this parent). PROJECT_STATE.md §3d: all 3 models systematically OVER-claim Antonymy (false positives > true positives at baseline, e.g. Claude strict precision=0.263) -- its headline weakness in the LLM experiments is a PRECISION failure, not just low recall. A from-scratch verse-level binary classifier (this phase's task framing) has no equivalent 'over-claims a span then gets the wrong one' failure mode, so this subtype's LLM-measured difficulty may not transfer directly to the classifier's own precision/recall balance -- flagged for that reason, not because the recall evidence itself is thin (n=38, 114 poems, Phase1+Phase3 agree in direction: this subtype is hard).

Kenning/Periphrasis is Phase1's frozen worst-performing parent (F1 avg 0.109, lowest of 4) and this is its lowest-average-recall above-threshold subtype among the 4 Kenning candidates, so the parent- and subtype-level signals agree on 'hard'. BUT Phase3's own in-house run-to-run count swung 14/20 to 10/20 (70%->50%) between its two runs on a small (n=20) sample within that specific frozen-TEST experiment -- flagged as the least run-stable evidence of the 5, even though the subtype's larger full-corpus count used for this phase's training (n=280 positive verses, 90 poems) is itself large and stable.

rejected_as_out_of_scope.reason: derivation/paronomasia -- not one of the project's 4 rhetorical elements (طباق/تشبيه/مجاز/كناية), no LLM difficulty evidence exists for it
"returning the endings to the beginnings" (a sound/structure device) -- same as above
